[הוּן] verb be easy (Arabic be light, easy, compare , (see אוּן), Aramaic Late Hebrew הוֺן gentleness, , is mind, sense; see conjectures on development of meanings Fl ChWB i. 423) — only Hiph`il Imperfect וַתָּהִינוּ followed by Infinitive Deut 1:41 regard as easy to go up, or make light of going up; so Thes Kn Ke Di RVm (construct. as Num 14:44 וַיַּעְפִּלוּ לַעֲלוֺת, though || to this in Deuteronomy is vNum 14:43).
